facts.text: Guests stay in free-standing, thatch-roofed hale.
facts.excerpt: The free-standing, thatch-roofed hale are modern, elegant and seamlessly at one with their natural surroundings.

facts.text: Hale feature oversized lanai and outdoor showers.
facts.excerpt: Featuring oversized lanai and outdoor showers

facts.text: The Beach Front Black Sand Two Bedroom Kauhale has a lanai staircase leading directly onto a black sand beach with views of Kahuwai Bay.
facts.excerpt: a lanai staircase leading directly onto an intimate black sand beach and sweeping views of Kahuwai Bay

facts.text: The Ocean Front Four Bedroom Maheawalu Kauhale sits on oceanfront lava rock with a private plunge pool and hot tub.
facts.excerpt: Breathtaking presidential-style residence perched on ocean front lava rock with private plunge pool, hot tub, expansive entertaining space and four king beds.

facts.text: Shipwreck Bar was once the schooner of resort founder Johnno Jackson.
facts.excerpt: Once the beloved schooner of resort founder Johnno Jackson, Shipwreck Bar has been restored to its former splendor

facts.text: Moana restaurant honors the historic fishing village that once thrived on the site.
facts.excerpt: Moana honors the historic fishing village that once thrived here.

facts.text: Kahuwai Cookhouse has a menu inspired by paniolo (Hawaiian cowboy) traditions.
facts.excerpt: Kahuwai Cookhouse celebrates the island's cowboy culture with a menu inspired by paniolo traditions.

facts.text: The resort has an on-site farm that provides produce for its restaurants.
facts.excerpt: The resort is home to an on-site farm which provides produce for our restaurants.

facts.text: Kona Village has four outdoor pools.
facts.excerpt: one of Kona Village’s four outdoor pools

facts.text: The Shipwreck Adult Pool has three tiers, including an infinity hot tub and a lap pool.
facts.excerpt: Shipwreck Adult Pool stands as a tropical haven with three inviting tiers including an infinity hot tub and 25-meter lap pool

facts.text: Guests can explore the 81-acre resort on complimentary bicycles.
facts.excerpt: Explore our 81 acres on complimentary bicycles exclusively for guest use.

facts.text: The Asaya Spa lounge has hot tubs, cold plunges, and steam and sauna rooms.
facts.excerpt: Relax your muscles with hot tub dips, cold plunges and time in the steam and sauna rooms.

facts.text: The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
facts.excerpt: our pristine and fully equipped pickleball and tennis courts

facts.text: Guests can join a sunrise paddle in outrigger canoes around Kahuwai Bay.
facts.excerpt: Climb aboard one of our outrigger canoes for a purposeful sunrise paddle around Kahuwai Bay.

facts.text: The Ka'uluola Cultural Center displays artifacts and offers immersive activities on Hawaiian history and culture.
facts.excerpt: A display of artifacts and immersive activities honors the history of the land and celebrates the vibrant culture of Hawai

facts.text: Guests can fish for invasive tilapia in the resort's lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Cast off into an eco-friendly experience at our lagoon, where we're tackling an invasive species: tilapia.

facts.text: Kahuwai Bay offers snorkeling among marine life.
facts.excerpt: Our sanctuary, Kahuwai Bay, teems with vibrant marine life.

facts.text: The resort presents itself as a retreat for families.
facts.excerpt: An inviting retreat for families, these historic lands hold wonders for guests of every generation.

facts.text: Guests can learn traditional palm weaving.
facts.excerpt: Watch and learn traditional palm weaving using a time-honored technique passed down through generations.
